rows.text: 18 February 2014

At its meeting on 18 February, the Monetary Council reviewed the latest economic and financial developments and voted to reduce the central bank base rate by 15 basis points from 2.85% to 2.7%, with effect from 19 February 2014.
In the Council’s judgement, Hungarian economic growth is likely to continue this year and next.

In the Council’s judgement, Hungarian economic growth is likely to continue this year and next.
While the pace of economic activity is strengthening, output remains below its potential and is likely to come close to that level again at the end of the horizon relevant for monetary policy.
